image:image.image:title: Mobile-Ready Pages — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: 30% of ChatGPT users are on mobile, make sure your landing page is ready

image:image.image:title: Simple Images — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Keep the image simple. Big screenshots of platforms work best

image:image.image:title: Short and Sweet — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: The key to a good ChatGPT ad is short and sweet. You have limited space

image:image.image:title: Sentence Descriptions — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: You can fit a full sentence in the description, but keep it punchy

image:image.image:title: Ad Placement — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Ads appear after the AI's answer, so the copy should fit that context

image:image.image:title: A New Platform — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: ChatGPT is a new ad platform. It's basic, and it will keep changing

image:image.image:title: Skip the Brand Name — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Don't repeat your brand name, the ad placement already shows it

image:image.image:title: Optimize Each Element — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Optimize every element of the ad separately to build something strong

image:image.image:title: Different to Google — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Similar to Google, but different. Users get answers, not links

image:image.image:title: Description Character Limit — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Descriptions say 100, but make them 70 to be safe on mobile

image:image.image:title: Short Headlines — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: 4 to 5 word headlines look best, they draw the user in

image:image.image:title: Headline Character Limit — The Playbook ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: The limit says 50, but make it 30 so it isn't cut off on mobile

image:image.image:title: Four Components — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example

image:image.image:title: Short and Small — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Focus on short copy as you don't get much. Use an image which is simple as it's very small

image:image.image:title: Country Selection — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: You select your country. The selection is limited right now

image:image.image:title: Daily Budget — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: Two options for budget pacing. Go with daily for more budget control

image:image.image:title: Campaign Objective — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example
image:image.image:caption: There are two options for objective. Conversions has a coming soon message

image:image.image:title: Conversion Event — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example

image:image.image:title: Tracking Setup — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example

image:image.image:title: Install Guide — The Setup ChatGPT Ads example
